resource.prompt:
Create unit and integration tests in tests/ for the Closed-Loop Knowledge Sync and Multi-Family Drift engine:
1. Test scripts/lib/knowledge_sync.js: classifyKnowledgeScope across all 5 families (ProLiant, Synergy, Alletra, StoreEver, Cray) for UNIVERSAL_VENDOR, FAMILY_GEN, and CHASSIS_SPECIFIC taxonomy.
2. Test scripts/lib/sync/sync_payload_builder.js and scripts/lib/post_flow_sync.js: verify test chassis payloads route to outputs/temp/test_payloads/ (INV-7) and cleanTestPayloads() executes cleanly.
3. Test master_knowledge_registry.json generation with canonical generatedAt and schemaVersion fields (INV-4).
Ensure all tests pass with npm run test:all.
